name: wa-multi-device-controller
author: Rifky
description: WA Multi-Device Controller oleh Rifky — panel WhatsApp multi-nomor fullstack (Next.js 14 + Baileys + Socket.io + Prisma), UI Bahasa Indonesia, login panel

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-db.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx watch --ignore "data/**" --ignore ".next/**" --clear-screen=false server.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-db.mjs && prisma generate && next build
scripts.start: node scripts/prepare-db.mjs && prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx server.ts
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/prepare-db.mjs && prisma generate && node scripts/patch-status-stream.mjs
